title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology NAA Detection Amplification

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Specific determination: Nucleic-acid detection — amplification technique asserted', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Same, restricted to Technique = << Molecular nucleic acid amplification technique (probe with target amplification, PCR ...). Shows how much a technique clause loses: the generic 'by molecular genetics' and the technique-free codes fall out. Parts: LOINC enumeration (1524, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
